text:
The satellite evidence did not detect any tree clearing on this property between 2021 and 2025. The analysis covered the full 130.9 ha, with valid observations over all of it, through 2025.

Little forest was there to begin with. Hansen data show only about 0.4 ha of tree cover in 2000, and the JRC map shows no forest in 2020.

This is not proof that no trees were cut. The method only detects loss events of 0.5 ha or more, using 30 m pixels. Small clearings, narrow strips, or edge changes could be missed. The result also says nothing about legal or regulatory status, such as EUDR compliance, and nothing about periods outside 2021–2025.

In short: no larger-scale tree loss was detected after 2020, but minor tree removal can't be ruled out.
